name: Hornero Quiet Notes
description: Quiet Notes 2.0: dashboard card for one short session-only intention. The line is never saved (in-memory only, as in 1.x) and the card says so. Keyboard-first capture, no processes or network.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Notes and Focus 2.0: explicit Session only - never saved labelling distinct from persistent Quick Notes, keyboard-first capture (UiButton, themed editor, Enter/Esc) replacing the mouse-only card click and its hard-coded colours, Ui primitives with Theme tokens, typed display preferences (140-char default as in 1.x; the intention itself is deliberately not a setting) and Argentine Spanish catalog.
Calm dashboard card for one short intention for this session; in-memory only, gone when the shell closes.

maxLength.description: Maximum characters for the session intention (140 in 1.x). Preference only: the intention itself is never stored.

showCounter.description: Show the remaining-characters hint while editing (shown in 1.x).
